implementation.name: Darius2 Ninja Warriors (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 144 HDL source files (35 systemverilog, 102 verilog, 7 vhdl) alongside 1 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: 5 MRA files in the repository's releases/ directory carry a <setname>; 2 resolved exactly to a MAME 0.288 machine and 3 through MAME's own cloneof relation to the parent set that survives extract/machine.json's parents-only filter, giving 2 distinct machine_id rows. license_id omitted: https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Arcade-Darius2NinjaWarriors_MiSTer/blob/master/LICENSE is the verbatim GNU GPL version 3 text, but neither only-this-version nor any-later-version is stated there or in the HDL headers read (Template.sv, build_id.v), and GPL's version scope comes from the grant, not the licence text. GPL-3.0-only and GPL-3.0-or-later are both consistent with what the repository actually says. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 144 source files (35 systemverilog, 102 verilog, 7 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.
